question: From which center must Kundalini be raised in this practice?
premises: Muladhara is named as the starting point
Kundalini is the object to be raised
Kundalini has the form of Brahman
inference: The practitioner must raise Brahman-formed Kundalini from Muladhara
plain_english: Having raised Kundalini, whose form is Brahman, from the Muladhara...
